verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say you can add unique custom domains to projects, and its REST API covers DNS management. Automatic HTTPS is documented, and community users independently confirm 'custom domains with SSL' in practice. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the domain attachment flow (DNS record setup, verification, apex vs. subdomain handling); the evidence consists only of brief summary lines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach custom domains to my deployed services

citations.quote: Simplify domain management for your projects and add unique custom domains for different versions of your project.
Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API
